verdict.line: You lose if Aatrox lands Q (The Darkin Blade) and W (Infernal Chains) freely before level 6; you win if you survive to a 2-item Trinity Force spike and force extended trades with E (Counter Strike).

brief.thesis: Aatrox's Q (The Darkin Blade) has three swings on a 14/12/10/8/6s cooldown and his Passive (Deathbringer Stance) periodically empowers an auto with bonus magic damage and healing based on your max health, which is why he holds a measured 256-game edge and a solo-kill advantage. Your answer is E (Counter Strike): it dodges all incoming basic attacks and reduces AoE damage while it's up, so timing it onto his empowered Passive auto both denies the heal and lands your own stun.

theirWindow.when: Passive lit + Q (The Darkin Blade) off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can land an empowered auto for the heal and follow with Q swings that punish you for standing in melee range. Back off and force him to walk the Q swing to you instead of standing in it.

yourWindow.when: His E (Umbral Dash) is on cooldown (9/8/7/6/5s)
yourWindow.what: Without Umbral Dash he can't reposition or reset the heal-on-hit passive tied to it. Use Q (Leap Strike) into W (Empower) to force a trade while he has no dash to disengage or chase.

powerCurve.note: His Passive heal and Q punish early all-ins

start.why: 50% win rate over 208 games and the 62.3% pick rate reflect that the extra early trade damage and sustain matter more than Doran's Shield's damage reduction against Aatrox's burst-and-heal pattern.

boots.why: 46.3% win rate over 218 games and 71.7% pick rate; the flat damage reduction on consecutive autos blunts Aatrox's empowered Deathbringer Stance hits and his Q swings.

core.why: The most run first core item; the damage and tempo spike is what finally lets you win trades you were losing levels 1-8.
Highest-performing second item path (61.9% win rate over 21 games) and pairs with your on-hit E (Counter Strike) stun window for a burst-and-heal trade.
Completes the top-performing path; lets you survive his R (World Ender) all-in window and R (Relentless Assault) attack-speed dives without dying to burst.

situational.when: you need sustained DPS and kiting power instead of burst against a healing-heavy aatrox
aatrox is snowballing and you need to survive his empowered passive autos and q swings
you want additional stats to close the mid-game gap before your third core item

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-pickrate page (30.5%) at 44% win rate; ramping attack speed rewards standing in prolonged trades once you've timed E (Counter Strike) to deny his Passive heal, which is exactly the trade pattern this matchup asks for.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the strongest measured combo here (51.2% win rate, 13.1% pick) versus Flash+Ignite's 47.3%; given Aatrox's early lane advantage, Teleport lets you play safe/passive without losing tempo to the rest of the map.

playing.title: Hold E for his Passive proc
playing.detail: Watch for Aatrox's Passive (Deathbringer Stance) glow before he autos. Time your E (Counter Strike) to dodge that specific auto — it denies both the bonus magic damage and the healing that fuels his solo-kill advantage.

playing.title: Don't stand in Q sweeps
playing.detail: The Darkin Blade has three swings on a 14/12/10/8/6s cooldown, each with a different area. Step out after he commits to a swing rather than trading through all three.

playing.title: Trade only when Umbral Dash is down
playing.detail: His E (Umbral Dash) heals him on damage and lets him reposition. Track its 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown and only extend fights when it's unavailable.

playing.title: Respect level 6 all-in
playing.detail: R (World Ender) gives him attack damage, healing, and move speed and fears nearby minions. Play for the wave rather than contesting trades right as he hits 6.

playing.title: Use Q-W to punish overextension
playing.detail: Jax's Q (Leap Strike) into W (Empower) lets you burst him the moment his E (Umbral Dash) is on cooldown and he's pushed past his minions.

playing.title: Play for your Trinity Force spike
playing.detail: The matchup is measured at only 48% win rate over 256 games, so don't force early fights. Farm safely under E (Counter Strike) threat range and look to flip the lane once Trinity Force completes.

playing.title: Buy into his healing
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup flags Aatrox's sustain from both Passive and Umbral Dash — prioritize Sundered Sky and Death's Dance in your situational slots specifically to cut that healing down.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own tactical read layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Aatrox’s The Darkin Blade (Q)! Use Counter Strike [E] to block his Deathbringer Stance (P). Purchase items that reduce healing.
